current_scope.purpose: Public minimized operators registry reference for R&D documentation, hash-oriented operator proof commitments, operator role references, IPR / IPR Card relations where applicable, audit-trail continuity and deterministic verification review.
current_scope.public_position: This registry is an R&D proof-reference surface. It is not a public authority operator registry, not a professional licensing register, not a regulated certification register, not an eIDAS qualified trust service, not a regulated KYC/AML provider, not a custodial identity service, not a public identity registry and not a production compliance framework by itself.
current_scope.operational_boundary: Public operator entries are minimized proof references. They do not expose names, emails, phone numbers, private identity evidence, tax codes, national identifiers, document numbers, identity documents, raw personal identifiers, credentials, secrets, private keys, production logs, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files or sensitive operational payloads.

OPERATOR_RND_REFERENCE.interpretation: Technical R&D operator reference. It does not create legal operator status, active onboarding, regulated certification, professional licensing or production authorization.

OPERATOR_IPR_BASE.interpretation: Operator reference connected to an IPR Base profile. It is not verified identity and does not create legal authorization.

OPERATOR_IPR_VERIFIED.interpretation: Operator reference connected to IPR Verified private verification. Identity evidence and national identifier evidence may exist only in the private verification layer. Public records remain minimized.

OPERATOR_PROFESSIONAL_PILOT.interpretation: Future professional pilot profile based on IPR Verified. It does not create regulated professional qualification, public authority approval or production authorization by itself.

OPERATOR_IPR_CARD.interpretation: Operator reference connected to IPR Card operational access-state modeling. It does not create an official identity card, regulated access credential or automatic JOKER-C2 access.

rules.public_operator_interpretation: A public operator entry proves only that a public proof reference exists. It does not certify legal authorization, professional qualification, public authority approval, regulated compliance, KYC/AML compliance, cybersecurity assurance, institutional mandate, operational activation, JOKER-C2 access or production authorization.
rules.production_interpretation: R&D and public proof entries must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, professional licensing, production compliance validity, cybersecurity assurance, legal operator certification, active onboarding, JOKER-C2 access or operational authorization unless independently supported by a lawful production framework.

privacy_note: This public operators registry must not store names, emails, phone numbers, private identity evidence, tax codes, fiscal codes, national identifiers, document numbers, identity documents, identity document scans, raw personal identifiers, credentials, secrets, private keys, production logs, raw AI prompts, raw AI outputs, client files, regulated identity documents, financial assets, confidential payloads or sensitive operational material. Public operator records should use minimized public labels and hash-oriented proof commitments.
empty_registry_interpretation: An empty entries array means no public operator proof entries are currently available in this registry file. It does not certify absence of activity, validity, authorization, operator status, compliance status, security status, professional qualification, active onboarding, JOKER-C2 access or operational activation by itself.

constraints.operator_id: Public minimized operator identifier only; must not contain names, emails, phone numbers, tax codes, national identifiers, document numbers, private evidence, identity documents, secrets, credentials, client data, internal endpoints or operational authorization claims.
constraints.operator_label: Public minimal operator label only; must not contain raw personal identifiers.
constraints.operator_type: RND_OPERATOR | IPR_OPERATOR | REVIEWER_REFERENCE | ISSUER_REFERENCE | AUDITOR_REFERENCE | SUPPORT_REFERENCE | SYSTEM_OPERATOR_REFERENCE
constraints.ipr_card_id: Optional public IPR Card reference only.
constraints.verification_level: L0 | L1 | L2 | L3 | IPR_BASE_NOT_VERIFIED | IPR_VERIFIED_PRIVATE_CHECK | IPR_PROFESSIONAL_PILOT | RND_ONLY | NOT_APPLICABLE
constraints.operator_status: PENDING | ACTIVE | REVIEW_REQUIRED | SUSPENDED | REVOKED | EXPIRED | RND_ONLY | RETAINED | PRIVATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED | FAIL_CLOSED
constraints.timestamp: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 parseable timestamp with timezone when available
constraints.status: Public lifecycle status only; must not be interpreted as professional licensing or production authorization.

verification.fail_closed_rule: Missing, malformed, ambiguous, placeholder-based, forbidden-field-based or inconsistent registry state must not produce VALID.
verification.production_rule: RND_ONLY, RETAINED, L0, L1, L2, L3, IPR_BASE_NOT_VERIFIED, IPR_VERIFIED_PRIVATE_CHECK and IPR_PROFESSIONAL_PILOT statuses must not be interpreted as regulated certification, public authority approval, professional licensing, production compliance validity, cybersecurity assurance, legal operator certification, active onboarding, JOKER-C2 access or operational authorization by themselves.
